title: b7z9.29.6: C: port CCP-15 metrics layer (peer counting, BusyPercent, evaluation)
description: Port the Python/Rust metrics layer to C/Zephyr. C already has: density report API (lora_l2_tx.c:569-578), CAD gate (link_cca.c), composite TX path (lichen_link_tx.c). Wire peer counting from L2 RX path, BusyPercent from TX airtime tracking, periodic evaluation from TDMA tick. Depends on .29.1-.29.5 landing the design in Python/Rust first.
